sv.title: C-toppens krav: Rösta gult – annars sviker vi
sv.summary: Centerpartiet borde rösta gult till Ulf Kristersson – annars sviker partiet sina vallöften, menar EU-parlamentarikern Abir Al-Sahlani (C). Nu utesluter hon inte att lämna partiet. – Det är dags att tala lite klarspråk. Människor är inte så dumma, alltså. Det räcker nu, säger hon.

en.title: Centre Party leadership's demand: Vote yellow – otherwise we betray
en.summary: The Centre Party should vote yellow for Ulf Kristersson (M) – otherwise the party betrays its election promises, argues MEP Abir Al-Sahlani (C). Now she does not rule out leaving the party. – It is time to speak plainly. People are not that stupid, you know. Enough is enough, she says.
